$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: An expired, mismatched, or evicted resume starts a fresh session
summary: When the offered resumeSessionId does not match a retained session, the TTL has expired, or a newer connection or task has replaced it, acceptance returns a fresh sessionId and resumed: false. The desktop rebuilds from the intention repeated by a later v1 observation; old IDs and output are rejected.

steps.note: Exact closed v1 hello on the new connection. Wire mode resets to v1. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.1, §5)
resumeSessionId names a session that is expired, mismatched, or evicted. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §5)
Fresh sessionId, resumed: false. Old IDs and output from the prior session are stale and MUST NOT affect this session. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §5)

outcome: A fresh session starts. The phone MUST treat any prior-session state, action, or image as stale and harmless.
